published_ranges._hdt_0.45MPa: 81 dry / 61 wet (Method B); Method A 73.5 dry / 48.5 wet
published_ranges._notes: Unfilled polyphthalamide. Melting point 231C. Raft separation 0.12-0.16 mm. PEI with glue stick/PVP. Store <15% RH. Annealing not recommended (warps). No Bambu PPA preset; Generic PA used.

conflicts: TDS introduction states density 1.2 g/cm3; property table gives 1.21 (ISO 1183) - table value used: https://siraya.tech/pages/siraya-tech-fibreheart-ppa-filament-tds

Product page recommends hardened steel nozzles and a heating block of at least 12 mm; TDS says a hardened steel nozzle is not needed: https://siraya.tech/products/siraya-tech-fibreheart-ppa-3d-printing-filament
